DomainData.MainInfoText: Ina toro koe i tētahi paetukutuku, ka rokiroki pea, ka tiki pea rānei i ngā mōhiohio kei tō pūtirotiro, ko te tikanga hei pihikete. Mōu pea aua mōhiohio, mō ō manakohanga, tō pūrere, ka whakamahia rānei ki te whakarite kia mahi te pae pēnā i tāu e tūmanako ai. Ko te tikanga, kāore aua mōhiohio e tautohu tika i a koe, engari ka taea te whakarato i te wheako e nui ake ai te whakawhaiaro. Ka āhei te kōwhiri ki te tuku i ētahi momo pihikete. Pāwhiria ngā upoko kāwai rerekē kia whiwhi mōhiohio anō me te huri i ā mātou tautuhinga taunoa. Heoi, me mōhio ka pāngia pea tō wheako i te pae me ngā ratonga ka tukuna e mātou mā te aukati i ētahi momo pihikete.
DomainData.AlertNoticeText: Ka whakamahi pihikete mātou kia pai ai te mahi a tā mātou pae, ki te whakawhaiaro ihirangi me ngā pānuitanga, ki te whakarato āhuahira pāhopori me te tātari i ā mātou whakawhitinga. Ka tiritiri mōhio anō hoki mātou mō tō whakamahi i te pae me ā mātou pāhopori, pānuitanga, me ngā hoa tātaritanga,Cookie Notice

DomainData.CookieListDescription: Ko tēnei mea te pihikete he pito raraunga iti (he kōnae kuputuhi) e tono ana tētahi paetukutuku – ina torohia e te kaiwhakamahi – i tō pūtirotiro ki te rokiroki ki tō pūrere hei maumahara mōhiohio mōu, pēnei i tō manako reo, ō mōhiohio takiuru rānei.E tautuhia ana ēnei pihikete e mātou, ā, e tapaina ana he pihikete hunga-tuatahi.Whakamahi pihikete ai hoki ngā hunga-tuatoru – he pihikete ēnei mai i te rohe rerekē i tō te paetukutuku e toro ana koe – mō ā mātou pānuitanga me ngā mahi whakamākete. Ina hoki, e whakamahi pihikete ana mātou me ētahi atu hangarau taki mō ēnei pūtake:

FirstPartyCookies.Name: OptanonConsent
FirstPartyCookies.description: Kua tautuhia tēnei pihikete e te tautuku o ngā pihikete mai i OneTrust. Ko ngā mōhiohio e penapena ana mō ngā kāwai o ngā pihikete ka whakamahia te pae, ā, ka tukua ngā whakapaunu, ka whakaae rānei mō te whakamahinga o ia kāwai. Ka whakahohe tēnei pae i rangatira hei ārai i ngā pihikete ki ia kāwai i roto i te pūtirotiro kaiwhakamahi, inā kāore i te tuku whakaaetanga. He mea pūnoa te lifespan o nga pihikete i te kotahi tau, kia mahara ai nga manuhiri ki te pae. Kāore he mōhiohio e taea ai te tohu i te manuhiri pae.
